## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /api/auth/token/` — Obtain an authentication token.
- `GET /v1/projects/{projectToken}/settings` — Get project settings using a project token for authentication.
- `POST /api/graphql/GenerateWebsocketJwt/` — Generate a JWT for WebSocket authentication.

### Data Read (10)
- `GET /{id}/` — Get details for a specific object by ID.
- `GET /dashboard/start` — Retrieve initial dashboard data.
- `GET /finance` — Retrieve financial information.
- `GET /joined/{joinedId}/` — Get details about a joined entity by ID.
- `POST /api/graphql/fetchAccessPassMembersV2/` — Fetch members of an access pass.
- `POST /api/graphql/FetchHasInvestigationAccess/` — Check if the user has access to investigations.
- `POST /api/graphql/MessagesFetchChatFeed/` — Fetch the chat feed for a specific channel.
- `POST /api/graphql/MessagesFetchDmsChannels/` — Fetch direct message channels.
- `POST /api/graphql/MessagesFetchUpdatedFeedEntities/` — Fetch updated feed entities.
- `POST /home-feed/` — Fetch paginated feed updates

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /{id}/courses/{id}` — Enroll a user in a specific course.
- `POST /api/graphql/MarkFeedPostsAsViewed/` — Mark feed posts as viewed.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Write/update data associated with a specific ID.

### Search (2)
- `GET /discover/users/` — Search for users based on criteria.
- `POST /api/graphql/FetchPopularUsers/` — Find popular users.

### Config (5)
- `GET /core/api/flags/experiment/{experimentId}` — Fetch configuration for an experiment flag.
- `GET /core/api/flags/experiment/{experimentId}/` — Get details about a specific experiment.
- `GET /core/api/flags/feature_gate/{feature_gateId}` — Fetch configuration for a feature gate flag.
- `GET /core/api/flags/feature_gate/{feature_gateId}/` — Check the status of a specific feature gate.
- `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/settings` — Retrieve settings for a specific project.

### Core API (6)
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchAccessibleExperienceIds/` — Fetch IDs of accessible experiences.
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchNotificationBadgesV2/` — Get notification badge counts for the viewer.
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchUserNotificationPreferences/` — Fetch detailed notification preferences for a user.
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchUserSimpleNotificationPreferences/` — Get simple notification preferences for a user.
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchViewerInfo/` — Retrieve information about the current viewer.
- `POST /api/graphql/coreFetchViewerWhops/` — Fetch the Whops associated with the current viewer.

}
